name: Auto Ranging
teaser: Your scope zeroes itself to whatever you're aiming at. Aim, and the sight snaps to the closest zeroing distance — no clicking through steps mid-fight. Now also zeroes for the ammo actually in your gun, not the weapon's default round.
description_html:
Description

Your scope zeroes itself to whatever you’re aiming at, and now accounts for the ammo you actually loaded.

Ranging

  • Auto — while ADS, the mod checks the distance ahead every 0.3s and keeps the zero matched to your target
  • Manual — flip Auto Range off and range on demand with Alt+R (rebindable)

Ammo aware zeroing

Tarkov calibrates your scope against the weapon’s default ammo no matter what you loaded. An AK-74 is always zeroed for PS gs at 890 m/s — load 5.45 US gs at 303 m/s and your rounds land well under the reticle, visibly so from about 100 m.

  • Zeroing is recalculated from the cartridge actually chambered, using the game’s own trajectory solver
  • Re-solves when you switch ammo mid-raid
  • Does nothing when the loaded round is already the weapon’s default
  • Toggleable, on by default
Install Instructions
  1. Extract the archive
  2. Drop the BepInEx folder into your SPT root directory
  3. Optionally set your preferences in the F12 menu

Requires SPT 4.1.x. Upgrading from 1.0.0 is a straight overwrite. Still on SPT 4.0? Stay on v1.0.0.

Known Limitations / Bugs

None currently known. If you find one, please report it (see Support tab).

Support

Found a bug or have a question? Leave a comment on this mod’s page, or reach out in my thread on the SPT Discord: https://discord.com/channels/875684761291599922/1521972310595338260
